# What a zero Config resolves to in Dial, and the package limits and budgets a caller can run into.
# A change here is a change of behavior for every caller that left the field out: the pull request names its consumers
# (defect class DC-C03 of docs/defect-classes.md). Update with: UPDATE_DEFAULTS=1 go test -run TestTheConfigDefaultsAreTheSnapshot
